question: Should repository security approve the current-head dependency graph and the new device-pairing/operator-token AG-UI HTTP boundary before this feature proceeds?
rationale: Only repository security or an authorized admin can accept the new resolved dependency graph and decide whether the proposed browser-facing authentication model meets OpenClaw’s security requirements.

options.title: Require external-plugin delivery and approval
options.body: Recommended: make the installation model consistent with the excluded core distribution, then obtain approval for the resulting dependency graph and authentication boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled channel
options.body: Keep it bundled only after including the runtime in packaged builds, explicitly approving the dependencies, and validating both fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Pause or close the branch if no owner wants to sponsor a new official AG-UI channel and its ongoing security/dependency maintenance.

recommendation.title: Require external-plugin delivery and approval
recommendation.body: Recommended: make the installation model consistent with the excluded core distribution, then obtain approval for the resulting dependency graph and authentication boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing dependency guard explicitly assigns approval of intentional graph changes to this security route.
